A '''braised mushroom''' is a cooked brown [[mushroom]]. It heals {{Hp|2}}, is eaten quickly and has no effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/braised_brown_mushroom.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A brown mushroom cooks into a braised mushroom in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up a brown mushroom unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a braised mushroom takes 0.8 seconds and heals {{Hp|2}}.

Obtaining a braised mushroom unlocks [[Pickled Mushrooms|pickled mushrooms]] and [[stroganoff]]. It is also used in [[Mushroom Pizza|mushroom pizza]] and [[bokguk]].
